caption: The drawing features a large, brown, earthenware jug with a single handle extending from the neck to the upper body. The jug has a rounded, elongated form that tapers to a narrower base, and its surface is shaded to suggest a textured ceramic material. On the upper portion of the jug’s body, there is a blue and dark green floral motif, possibly painted or glazed onto the pottery. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a rectangular detail showing a decorative design of a blue bird perched on a stylized branch with leaves and berries, likely an enlargement or related detail of the decoration on the jug. In the lower right corner, a smaller sketch of the jug appears with dimensions labelled, indicating the height and width of the jug (19 1/4 inches tall and 8 1/2 inches wide at its broadest point). The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the jug is centered within a neatly drawn rectangular border.
title: Jug
